title: You’re Not Who You Think You Are
topic: Dark Psychology: Manipulation tactics people secretly use in conversations
script: Did you know that the most manipulative people in your life are hiding in plain sight? They use the most insidious tactics to get what they want, and you’re completely unaware. (pauses) Your friends and family, your colleagues and acquaintances - they’re all using manipulation to control you. (quickens pace) You think it’s just a casual comment, a harmless joke, but it’s actually a carefully crafted trap to make you do their bidding. (pauses) So, the question is: are you being manipulated by someone you trust the most?
